content:
With YONO, you can manage your cheque book anytime, from anywhere. You can –
1) Request for a new Cheque Book
2) Enquire the clearing status of a particular cheque issued by you
3) Stop Cheque payment for a particular cheque issued by you
4) Revoke stop cheque request
5) Deposit a cheque using smart cheque deposit kiosk
6) Use positive Pay System
7) Check the Cheque Book Dispatch Status
Download YONO SBI
